newsitem.title: USA: Hughes Supply sets Metals Group acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Hughes Supply sets Metals Group acquisition.

text.p: Hughes Supply Inc said Tuesday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Metals Inc, Stainless Tubular Products Inc, and Metals Inc - Gulf Coast Division, collectively referred to as the Metals Group, for an undisclosed number of Hughes common shares.
The acquisition is subject to a number of contingencies, including regulatory approvals. It is anticipated this transaction will close by December 31, Hughes said.
Metals is a distributor of stainless steel, high temperature and corrosion resistant pipe, bar and flat products in the Mid-Continent and Gulf Coast markets.
